author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam unboxes three mailbag packages from viewers, including a prop replica he's long-researched from the Alien universe, a beautiful exercise in rug tufting, and one of the most incredibly detailed hammers he's ever seen! Thanks to Zachery, Tanner, and Dan for sending these lovely builds!

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
